sources.snippet: MediGuide: AI-Powered Medical Assistant Chatbot A complete end-to-end AI/ML project that transforms TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat into a medically informed chatbot using three parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods: Prompt Tuning, LoRA, and QLoRA.

sources.title: GitHub - mananms21/Mediguide-: MEDIGUIDE, a conversational AI chatbot ...
sources.snippet: MEDIGUIDE is a conversational AI chatbot fine-tuned to provide accurate, medically grounded responses to patient queries. We experiment with three cutting-edge fine-tuning strategies on the Falcon-7B model: Prompt Tuning, LoRA, and QLoRA.
